name: greprules
description: Use greprules to fetch greprules.io rule packs, run OpenGrep scans, and read agent-friendly results.

opengrep_mode.title: OpenGrep setup method
opengrep_mode.description: Choose managed for automatic OpenGrep setup, system to use an existing opengrep on PATH, or path for a specific executable. Recommended: managed.

opengrep_path.title: OpenGrep executable path
opengrep_path.description: Required only when setup method is path. Enter the absolute path to your opengrep executable.
